description: Concepts that last years: retrieval, evals, loops, injection, governance layers. Taught in the body of each lesson.
Names, versions, laws, prices and vendor features. Verify them against primary sources instead of memorizing them.
A fixed rhythm, such as quarterly, for checking each tracked item against its primary source.
One line: what changed, which part of your system it touches and what to do. Dated by the event itself; superseded entries stay as history.
The same practice for your own system: model snapshots, protocol revisions, SDK versions and policies, reviewed on a fixed cadence.
